data.long_meaning: Arjun means 'warrior' and Bijlani is a surname. Arjuna is a legendary hero from Hindu mythology, a central character in the Mahabharata epic. He was a great warrior and a devoted disciple of Lord Krishna. The name Arjun signifies courage, valor, and dedication. The name ArjunBijlani carries the meaning “Warrior Arrow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose ArjunBijlani usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior arrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
